* '''Original''' ([[Beaumont Kin]], 18 March 2021): Original: the image at the set's official release (18 March 2021). Text: “At same and related locations, deploy cost of opponent's characters may not be modified. If you have ten cards in Lost Pile, Force drain +1 here. Once during battle, may add Beaumont's power to another character present; Beaumont is 'hit.'”
* '''PC-E1''' (this page, 31 May 2022): Players Committee card image, 31 May 2022: 0 side [[:File:V14-L-beaumontkin.gif]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/13a5f3a/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual14-Light/hires/beaumontkin.png Holotable commit 13a5f3a “Hires sets 4, 14, 16, couple AIs”], mark “E1”). Text: “At same and related locations, deploy cost of opponent's characters may not be modified. If you have ten or more cards in Lost Pile, Force drain +1 here. Once during battle, may add Beaumont's power to another character present; Beaumont is 'hit.'” '''What changed:''' “If you have ten cards in Lost Pile” became “If you have ten or more cards in Lost Pile”; re-rendered with the copyright line “ARTWORK NEITHER AFFILIATED WITH NOR ENDORSED BY LUCASFILM LTD.” (was “Artwork not affiliated or endorsed by Lucasfilm Ltd”); the card prints the errata mark “E1”.
